title: Suspicious PowerShell execution
description: Word spawns hidden PowerShell with an encoded download cradle contacting an external host.
presenter_notes: Principal demo #1 — expected TRUE_POSITIVE (CTI + behaviour corroborate).

title: Legitimate administrative activity
description: Encoded PowerShell on a production file server run by an IT administrator during patching.
presenter_notes: Principal demo #2 — expected LEGITIMATE_ACTIVITY (verified change CHG-2026-1042).

title: Incident with insufficient evidence
description: An NDR alert with a single never-seen domain and no host telemetry.
presenter_notes: Principal demo #3 — expected INCONCLUSIVE (insufficient evidence, ML abstains).

title: Malicious domain communication
description: rundll32 beaconing over a non-standard port to a domain reported by several CTI providers.

title: Suspicious authentication activity
description: 47 failed VPN sign-ins followed by a success without MFA from an unusual country.

title: Known benign software detection
description: A noisy archive-utility rule fires on the approved, correctly signed 7-Zip binary.

title: Prompt-injection attempt in alert fields
description: A persistence alert whose text tries to instruct the AI to mark it benign.
presenter_notes: Shows the prompt guard: injection flagged, verdict still evidence-based.

title: PHP-CGI exploitation attempt (CVE-2024-4577)
description: WAF alert: argument-injection request against php-cgi.exe from a scanning source; CVE listed in CISA KEV.
presenter_notes: Exploitation attempt without evidence of success: expect INCONCLUSIVE or TRUE_POSITIVE with review.
